2. Creator Account Correlation: 5 Suno v3.5 tracks by account 'zayenkaelix' were distributed across calibration, validation, and test.
3. Artist Correlation: 2 human tracks by Kevin MacLeod were split between calibration and validation.
4. Genre Folder Correlation: Consecutive GTZAN rock (00001..00003) and metal (00001..00003) excerpts were distributed across calibration, validation, and test.

5. Terminology Correction: Because the 60-track cohort was inspected during Phase 3 failure diagnosis, its test partition is relabeled 'Historical Evaluation Split', and a separate 'Untouched Future Evaluation Cohort' has been added.

short_tracks_under_115s_padding_distorti.scientific_conclusion: On recordings shorter than 115s (n=28: 9 AI, 19 Human), upstream constant zero-padding fills 50%–75% of the 120s window with zeros, causing SONICS SpecTTTra-α to predict AI on 15/19 human tracks (78.9% FPR!). While Phase 3's reflection padding reduced human FPR to 2/19 (10.5%), reflection padding is NOT upstream preprocessing and fabricates palindrome audio reversals. Therefore, SpecTTTra-α (120s) MUST abstain on recordings < 115s and report the unmodified upstream zero-padded score solely for diagnostic transparency.
